title: Switch Models in the Middle of an Answer #Shorts
description:
One thread, two models: the picker opens mid-conversation and the next answer comes back from a different one.

Local Keep AI is a local-first AI workspace. Local models run on your own device, your conversations stay there, and when you ask for a file you get the actual file - not a description of one. Answers arrive with their sources listed and graded, ranking government and academic pages above commercial ones.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
- Runs locally: the local models' weights are downloaded to and run on your own device
- Real files: PDF, spreadsheet, CSV, presentation, image, audio, video
- Shows its work: every answer cites and ranks its sources
- Hundreds of models: local GGUF, Ollama, hosted and OpenRouter, one picker
- Everywhere: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows, Linux, web and a CLI
- Free plan, no card and no trial clock

LINKS

Documentation: https://localkeep.ai/docs
Download: https://localkeep.ai/downloads
